verdict.rationale: Kick's docs reference a Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet built on a double-entry ledger and chart of accounts. The P&L updates in real time, financial statements can be pulled via the CLI or MCP, and locked-period reports stay stable. However, a cash-flow statement is never mentioned, and arbitrary-period selection is not explicitly documented. missing for 10: documented cash-flow statement, explicit any-period/custom date-range report generation, dedicated report docs for P&L/balance sheet, independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: Your Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet are organized by the accounts in your CoA.
Your Profit & Loss updates in real time as transactions are categorized.
pull transactions or financial statements with the Kick CLI
Your AI can query transactions, generate reports, and update bookkeeping
Reports for locked periods remain accurate and stable.
